rationale: DESeq2 with ~condition and a case-vs-control Wald contrast fits an unpaired single-batch 60 vs 60 design, though the plan neither considers limma-voom at this scale nor sets the reference level explicitly. QC covers PCA and sample correlations but omits library sizes, a sex check, and any search for hidden structure or an outlier policy. The low-count filter is stated and tied to group size; normalization is implicit in DESeq2 rather than stated. Effect size is handled by post-hoc dual thresholding on shrunken LFC rather than a threshold in the test (lfcThreshold/TREAT) or a confidence interval, and enrichment leaves ORA vs fgsea undecided with no universe, version, or size window and ranks by LFC rather than a test statistic.
